config.script:
"""
	Authenticate supervisor and execute PAPO signature.
	"""
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger("PopupSupervisorAuth")
	
	try:
		# ==================== GET INPUT VALUES ====================
		userName = self.view.custom.user
		password = self.view.custom.password
		
		if not userName or not password:
			alerts.showAlert(
				state='warning',
				title='Campos Requeridos',
				message='Ingrese usuario y contrasena',
				btnTextPrimary='Aceptar',
				btnActionPrimary=''
			)
			return
		
		logger.info("Authentication attempt for user: " + str(userName))
		
		# ==================== AUTHENTICATE USER ====================
		authResult = system.security.validateUser(userName, password)
		
		if not authResult:
			logger.warn("Authentication failed for user: " + str(userName))
			
			alerts.showAlert(
				state='error',
				title='Error de Autenticacion',
				message='Usuario o contrasena incorrectos',
				btnTextPrimary='Aceptar',
				btnActionPrimary=''
			)
			return
		
		logger.info("User authenticated successfully: " + str(userName))
		
		# ==================== GET USER ROLES ====================
		userSource = self.session.custom.userSource
		userRoles = []
		
		try:
			# Get user object
			userInfo = system.user.getUser(userSource, userName)
			
			# Get roles from user object
			userRoles = list(userInfo.getRoles())
			
			logger.info("Roles retrieved: " + str(userRoles))
			
		except Exception as e:
			logger.error("Failed to get roles: " + str(e))
			userRoles = []
		
		# ==================== VALIDATE ALLOWED ROLES ====================
		allowedRoles = {"INTEGRADOR", "Administrator", "Supervisor_PAPO"}
		userRolesUpper = set([r.upper() for r in userRoles])
		allowedRolesUpper = set([r.upper() for r in allowedRoles])
		
		logger.info("User roles upper: " + str(userRolesUpper))
		logger.info("Intersection: " + str(userRolesUpper & allowedRolesUpper))
		
		if not (userRolesUpper & allowedRolesUpper):
			logger.warn("User " + str(userName) + " does not have required supervisor role")
			
			alerts.showAlert(
				state='error',
				title='Acceso Denegado',
				message='El usuario ' + str(userName) + ' no cuenta con los permisos para firmar',
				btnTextPrimary='Aceptar',
				btnActionPrimary=''
			)
			return
		
		logger.info("Role validation passed for user: " + str(userName))
		
		# ==================== GET USER DETAILS ====================
		firstName = ""
		lastName = ""
		
		try:
			# Use .get() method instead of getFirstName()/getLastName()
			firstName = userInfo.get("firstname") or ""
			lastName = userInfo.get("lastname") or ""
			
			logger.info("User details - First: '" + str(firstName) + "' | Last: '" + str(lastName) + "'")
			
		except Exception as e:
			logger.warn("Could not retrieve user first/last name: " + str(e))
			firstName = ""
			lastName = ""
		
		# ==================== BUILD DATA ANSWER JSON ====================
		dataAnswer = {
			"user": userName,
			"role": userRoles,
			"name": firstName,
			"lastname": lastName
		}
		dataAnswerStr = system.util.jsonEncode(dataAnswer)
		
		# ==================== GET FORM DATA FROM POPUP PARAMS ====================
		papoId = self.view.params.papoId
		nodeId = self.view.params.nodeId
		registerCode = self.view.params.registerCode
		workstationNodeId = self.view.params.workstationNodeId
		workstationId = self.view.params.workstationId
		dbConnection = self.view.params.dbConnection
		reference = self.view.params.reference
		logger.info("PAPO data - papoId: " + str(papoId) + " | nodeId: " + str(nodeId))
		
		# ==================== EXECUTE INSERT ====================
		sql = """
			INSERT INTO registerhistory 
			(Timestamp, DataAnswer, Status, PapoID, RegisterTypeID, [User], 
			 WorkstationNodeID, NodeID, WorkstationID, RegisterCode)
			VALUES (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
		"""
		
		args = [
			dataAnswerStr,
			"Revisado",
			papoId,
			10,
			userName,
			workstationNodeId,
			nodeId,
			workstationId,
			registerCode
		]
		
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(sql, args, dbConnection)
		
		logger.info("PAPO form signed successfully by: " + str(userName) + " - PapoID: " + str(papoId))
				
		# ==================== SHOW SUCCESS ALERT AND CLOSE POPUP ====================
		alerts.actionSuccess(
			title='Firma Exitosa',
			message='El formulario ' + str(reference) + ' ha sido firmado correctamente por ' + str(firstName)+' '+str(lastName)
		)
		
		system.perspective.closePopup("supervisorAuthPopup")
		
		logger.info("Popup closed - signature completed")
	
	except Exception as e:
		logger.error("Error in supervisor authentication: " + str(e))
		
		alerts.showAlert(
			state='error',
			title='Error del Sistema',
			message='Ocurrio un error inesperado. Contacte al administrador.',
			btnTextPrimary='Aceptar',
			btnActionPrimary=''
		)
